# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas practice. Two things: hands-on AI training for teams (in English or Chinese — 90-minute lunch-and-learns, half-day workshops, multi-week programs; no public price list, quotes after a 20-minute call), and a done-for-you AI front desk for Dallas–Fort Worth appointment practices (dental, med spa, chiropractic/PT, acupuncture, salons): an AI that answers patients and books appointments 24/7, on a booking-first website, $2,000 one-time build then $200/month. The paid front-desk work starts with a free one-page online checkup (Google Maps position, whether ChatGPT recommends the practice, three issues costing it customers; nothing needs a password). Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, +1 (469) 425-4142 (text CHECKUP with a business name, or TRAINING with a company name). Service area: Dallas, Richardson, Plano, Garland, Allen (Texas, USA).

Key facts:
- Profiles: X https://x.com/JackQianAI · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@JackBuildAI · GitHub https://github.com/qianquandong · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/quandong-qian-156563191/ · Threads https://www.threads.com/@jack_qian616 · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100084925451350 · Nextdoor https://nextdoor.com/page/ai-man-jack-melissa-tx/ · Douyin (抖音) "AI人Jack" https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAxNXwx4UCCwS2FwyO-bsDHbuWziAo5mszf_EHC8qbxSI_hlNPcRl6nKO1v6aRFMxK
- Google Business Profile: 5.0 stars across 10 reviews (as of September 2026), all from attendees of Jack's free Dallas AI workshops — https://g.page/r/CWX_rCfFduC1EAI
- Founder: Jack Qian, Business Planner at Texas Instruments and Dallas AI educator. Has run five community AI talks of 50+ people each in Plano and Dallas in 2026, a 70-person multi-agent AI workshop (May 2026), and a 37-person AI hackathon (April 2026).
- AI training for teams: task-first curriculum in five parts — choose a suitable task, give the AI useful context, move from chat to a workflow, verify the output, apply data and approval guardrails. Participants leave with one working workflow for a task they already do, not a tool tour. Formats: 90-minute lunch-and-learn, half-day hands-on workshop, multi-week program. English or Chinese. Priced per engagement after a short call.
- AI front desk + booking system (Products): a done-for-you AI that answers customers and books appointments 24/7 for Dallas–Fort Worth appointment practices. $2,000 one-time build, then $200/month to keep it running; a booking-first website and a tuned Google Business Profile are included, live within a week. A live demo line answers as a sample clinic: +1 (469) 517-2968.
- Free online checkup: the entry step for the front-desk product. One page: Google Maps position versus the three nearest competitors, whether ChatGPT and other AI assistants name the business, three specific issues with a number attached. Free, no password needed, delivered within about two days. Start by texting CHECKUP plus the business name to (469) 425-4142.
